name: Yaotome Mai
source: Freshman student. Cheerful and lively, but also like doing housework, cleaning in particular. Originally she was living with her mother, but after she passed away she began living alone. At that time, she received a letter saying she has an older brother and asked her to find him. She moved into the apartment shortly after.
translation: 一年级新生。她开朗活泼，也喜欢做家务，尤其擅长打扫。原本和母亲一起生活，母亲去世后便独自居住。那时，她收到一封信，得知自己有个哥哥，并被要求去寻找他。不久后，她搬进了公寓。
